features.heading: Game Features
features.f1desc: Construct lumber mills, mines, and barracks. Manage resources and expand your fortress.
features.f2desc: Deploy units and let them fight. Zero micromanagement required.
features.f3desc: Classic, One Shot, and Turbo Gatherer modes for different playstyles.
features.f4desc: Battle against up to 3 AI opponents with adjustable difficulty (Easy, Normal, Hard).
features.f5desc: Infinite procedurally generated maps across 4 sizes.
features.f6desc: Units auto-explore. Building placement determines discovery order.
features.f7desc: Lumberjacks, miners, soldiers, archers, mages — each with unique skills.
features.f8desc: Auto-targeting towers that shoot down enemies. Hold chokepoints and defend.
features.f9desc: Upgrade buildings into specialized variants. Shape your strategy.
features.f10desc: Fully animated environments with dynamic visual effects.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: The free version is 100% free, forever. No ads. No pay-to-win. All core gameplay, unlimited random maps, different game modes. Play in browser or on desktop. The Premium Steam version adds extra maps, exclusive game modes, cloud saves, and achievements.
faq.q2: What's the difference between free and Steam versions?
faq.a2: The free version includes the complete game with a selection of predefined maps and local saves on desktop apps. The planned Steam version will add cloud saves across devices, Steam achievements, extensive additional premium content (maps, game modes, campaign), and will help sustain ongoing development of the game.
faq.q3: Can I compile the "premium" version myself?
faq.a3: Technically yes! The code is 100% public. However, you won't get Steam features like cloud saves and achievements without the Steam API. Most players prefer the convenience of Steam.
faq.q4: How do I contribute to the project?
faq.a4: Fork the repository on GitHub, make your changes, and submit a pull request. See CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines. Contributions to all features (including premium) are welcome!
faq.a5: Yes! The game is actively developed. The free version receives core updates, bug fixes, and new features. When released, the Steam version will include extensive additional premium content including campaigns, exclusive maps, game modes, and continuous updates.
